desc:
Emerson Fittpialdi's 1970 Lotus 72, winner of two Driver's (Jochen Rindt, 1970 and Emerson Fittipaldi, 1972) and one Constructor's Championship (197). This is on display at the Formula 1 Exhibition in London's ExCeL Arena in an opening section displaying four cars and their team principals.
